label: Tiki
terms_note: Tiki seller account (Vietnam); app registered on the Developer Platform; OAuth 2 client credentials for the seller's own integration or authorization code for third-party apps; sandbox; rate limits not on the pages read; supports drop-shipping fulfilment model natively.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (app registered on the Developer Platform; client credentials at https://api.tiki.vn/sc/oauth2/token, or authorization-code seller authorisation; Bearer token)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the auditor.
auth: 1. Register an app on the Tiki Developer Platform → client id + secret.
2. Client-credentials token for the seller's own store, or authorization-code when the seller authorises the platform's app.
3. Bearer token on integration endpoints; test on api-sandbox.tiki.vn first.

endpoints.purpose: create products via request; track status

reference.limits: Not on the pages read. - Tiki seller agreement; developer app terms.
mcp_sdk: SDK: Postman examples in the docs

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: App id of an IN-HOUSE application registered on the Tiki Open Platform and connected to your seller store (in-house apps receive the seller's permissions via the client-credentials flow).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: App secret of the same application; sent with the id as HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic) to https://api.tiki.vn/sc/oauth2/token. Apps configured for client_secret_post are not supported by this adapter.

config_fields.name: warehouse_id
config_fields.help: Seller warehouse id (GET /integration/v2/sellers/me/warehouses) whose available quantity set_inventory writes.

adapter.terms: Tiki Open Platform (Vietnam). Prices are in VND.

me.note: Get seller: {id, name, active, operation_models, can_update_product, registration_status, live_at}.

update_listing.note: PUT /integration/v2/products/updateSku {product_id, price}: changes the LIVE price (VND) of one product, approved automatically; `listing_id` is the Tiki product_id. Stock is set_inventory; titles/descriptions go through product update requests (review), not here.

set_inventory.note: updateSku with warehouse_quantities [{warehouse_id, qty_available}] for the configured warehouse; identify the product by `sku` (original_sku) or `listing_id` (product_id, used first when given). Sellers with several warehouses should note Tiki's warning that warehouses missing from the array are set to 0 on the batch endpoint.

end_listing.note: Batch update PUT /integration/v2.1/products/updateSkus {data: [{product_id, status: 2}]} disables the product (status enum 1 enabled, 2 disabled, 3 hidden; reversible with 1).

list_orders.note: Order Listing V2 ?page&limit&status (a set expression such as in|queueing,successful_delivery or nin|processing,waiting_payment)&created_from_date ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', UTC+07:00). Tiki recommends excluding processing/waiting_payment (not yet accepted). total is invoice.grand_total in VND; items and shipping in raw.

not_offered.create_listing: New products are product REQUESTS (POST /integration/v2.1/requests) with category, attributes, images and option data that Tiki reviews; the vocabulary has no category or attributes.
not_offered.mark_shipped: Tiki's logistics partners carry most orders ('For other operation models, you don't need to update delivery status… already handled by Tiki'); seller-delivery orders only report a delivery OUTCOME (POST /integration/v2/orders/{code}/seller-delivery/update-delivery {status: successful_delivery|failed…}) and there is no call that submits a carrier and tracking number.

evidence: host api.tiki.vn: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
